summary: Prepare the M152 two-file provider smoke production-code SDK write lane for explicit approval.
requiredApprovalRecord: The user must explicitly approve M152 for only scripts/provider-contract-smoke.js and scripts/provider-api-smoke.js, including one bounded SDKThread proof and excluding CEP-panel, external-provider/OpenAI CLI planner, live CEP/AE, mutating-live and dependency changes.
preEnablementChecks: Confirm both planned production-code source files already exist before SDKThread creation.
Confirm the operation envelope validates with no planned path violations.
Run npm.cmd run codex:orchestrator:write-scaffold:contract after updating the local allowlist.
Run node --check orchestrator/run-write-capable-scaffold.mjs and node --check orchestrator/run-buffered-acceptance.mjs after local contract changes.
approvalEvidenceRequired: User approval text must include the exact two planned production-code smoke files.
Approval must exclude CEP-panel, external-provider/OpenAI CLI planner, live CEP/AE, mutating-live and dependency changes.
The bounded SDKThread proof must report only the two planned files changed after the pre-run snapshot.
The M152 smoke and check:rules must pass after the proof artifact is recorded.
rollbackPlan: If the bounded proof fails or edits any out-of-scope path, revert the M152 allowlist and audit packets and leave the prior M146 single-file production-code lane as the only production-ready claim.
